answer: Split-tally bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and splits a crystal tally in two. One half stays sealed in a comet vault; its match is filed in the public gale ledger. Each epoch a gale beacon names one tally in ten; its holder must show the private half, or a rented half burns it. The first half costs 45, the kth 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fake identities pay 3,042,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once for 45 and keeps the bond.
